title: Chapter 1134
paragraphs: Chapter 1134
Episode 259. The Truth of the World, Your Truth, My Truth (3)
Fast.
It wasn't a level he could have blocked easily even if his body were whole. Silyn was wielding a sword that was, for a Zipple, unbelievably destructive and precise.
Shiiiik!
Jin barely parried the blade that flew at his forehead and glared at Silyn. Her face was not visible due to her hood and white mask, but her eyes were chillingly cold.
'A Genesis Knight. Dammit, of all times, of all times now...!'
A Genesis Knight.
No, a magic swordsman. Jin, conscious of the Blue Flame forming in Silyn's grasp, took a step back. It was undoubtedly a magic that applied the secret techniques learned only by pure-blooded Zipples.
"I created a new magic recently. One that can track bloodstains even in dimensional passages... That's why I tore you up like that but didn't kill you."
Tracking bloodstains scattered in a dimensional passage.

That was something that only Silyn in the entire Demon Army could do. Valeria had no knowledge of this ability Silyn had recently developed, and after being struck by her sword, she had headed for the entrance to another legacy that existed in the passage.

And at that time, Valeria happened to use up all her remaining power to temporarily stop the time of the 677th dimension. She had found the legacy in a state that was practically no different from a corpse, and for that reason, she had not noticed Silyn entering with her the moment she opened the entrance.
Valeria was deducing the whole story in an instant.
It was just meaningless as there was no way to respond, just painful as she had already made a mistake that could not have been more fatal.
"But to not even notice that an enemy had entered this place with you, Valeria Hister... you were just a mere human in the end. Even though you've shown such great abilities until now..."
In his past and present lives combined, this was the first time Jin had seen the human named Valeria Hister show such a look of terror.
She too was not afraid of death.
Like the emotion Jin had felt when he created the stairs to climb Laprarosa, she was afraid that all the sacrifice and pain would disappear like a bubble and lose its meaning.
Silyn had more than enough power to make that happen. Unlike the two of them, Silyn was not injured, not even tired.
"Valeria!"
"Go! Jin, you just need to get in!"
Abandon Valeria and break through alone to the white gate.
Though painful, it was the choice he obviously had to make. Jin, with a devastated heart, was already trying to abandon her and go to the gate.
But he couldn't break through Silyn's sword. She relentlessly fired sword energy every time Jin moved.
His body was endlessly heavy.
The only reason Jin could endure while parrying the sword ki now was thanks to the realm of a Genesis Knight that he had achieved.

But enduring was his limit. Even that couldn't last long, and a fight couldn't even be established. In the first place, she was a person whose victory he couldn't guarantee even when his body was in perfect condition.
"Keoheok!"
"Give up, Jin Runcandel."
"Shut up...!"
A sharp Blue Flame extending from Silyn's grasp pierced Jin's right shoulder. The Blue Flame dug into his bones and flesh like a blade and seared his body from the inside.

In an instant, the fire spread throughout his whole body. Normally he could shake it off in an instant, but now there was no way. Tess, who could have helped him, had met her annihilation at Kelliark's hands earlier.
"Kaaaak!"
Jin let out a monstrous scream.
It wasn't because of the pain. It wasn't because the pain of being burned was agonizing.
It was because he couldn't think of any way to get past her and obtain Solderet's power. It felt like he would go mad and lose his mind if he didn't scream.
He spewed curses like a madman. Vicious words he had never once uttered in his life, as if possessed by a demon, poured out from between his clenched teeth.
His knees buckled. His already insufficient energy was swallowed by the flames and rapidly depleted, and the sight of the fallen Valeria came into view.
Her trembling irises, terrified. Her blood-soaked lips. Her small, tightly clenched fists. That despair.
Silyn roughly grabbed Valeria's hair and lifted her face.
"I didn't know you could make a face like this. Yes, Valeria Hister. Don't worry, I'll let you live."
"Just let us... go. No. Not us, let Jin go. Silyn, please..."
Begging. That was all Valeria could do. There was nothing she could do but beg for him to let Jin go.
He wanted to cover his ears. He felt he had never heard a more cruel and terrible sound in his life. Jin screamed even louder to avoid hearing Valeria's voice.

"Silyn... you're a person too, you're a human with a will too! Do you really want a future where Kelliark Zipple conquers all dimensions? Do you want an ending where the whole world flows only according to his desire? In that, even you will have no choice but to lose yourself. Even you will eventually be forced to mistake Kelliark's desire for your own. Such a world... for what on earth are you all doing this...!"
"You're noisy. What is that in your hand?"
Silyn's gaze fell on Valeria's fist.
The memories created for Jin.
Valeria instinctively tried to hide the blue orb. But there was nowhere to hide it.
"Th-this is."
"I've asked a pointless question."
Silyn easily pried open Valeria's clenched fist. Though she had gripped the memory so hard her fingers could have broken, it was no match for Silyn's strength.
The memories of Valeria, which Jin hadn't even had a chance to touch yet, ended up in Silyn's hand first.
"Ah, this is... a memory, isn't it?"
A strange light filled Silyn's eyes behind the mask.
As soon as she took the blue orb in her hand, she was facing a wave of memories flooding into her mind. A sensation of her mind becoming hazy as if in a dream arose, but she did not get lost in it.
She had to analyze it calmly and thoroughly.
What Solderet and Valeria Hister had prepared for Jin Runcandel.
For what purpose this harsh moment existed.
"Stop it, stop it!"
"Jin Runcandel. Do what you can. What are you going to do by screaming like that? Is that your limit?"

"Cut the crap! I'll do it even if you don't say so. I will kill you. I will tear you to shreds and kill you. If not now, then even in death. If not even in death, then in my next life. I will kill you and then I will meet my people."
As he said, Jin was crawling.
His body had truly reached its limit and was burning in the Blue Flame. Now, he probably couldn't even block a light sword energy fired by Silyn.
"That's... touching."
But Jin could not beg. He could not inflict such a wound on Valeria. With people waiting outside, with people looking only at him, he could not stay still.
He had to go, even if he had to crawl. Even if he could never win, as long as he didn't let go of his sword. As long as he didn't lose his grip on his sword.
'The future is unknown. The future... is unknown. It's not over yet. It's not over.'
His grip on the sword kept trying to loosen. His consciousness was cutting out every second.

But it was all familiar from his cadet days. Death? He had already seen with his own two eyes a great knight who had transcended death through struggle. He had even done it himself when fighting Paelito.
He just had to do that.

Like Ron, he would get up and fight even if he died. He would do it again. Even if his whole body turned to ash in the Azure Flame, he would get up again and shove his sword into Silyn's neck. And he would cut down Kelliark, and he would meet his loved ones again.
He would protect them.
The land where they must live. Even if there wasn't much of it left intact, he would protect it. That, at least, he would protect.
Jin was crawling on the floor with that one conviction. Even when an endless agony, as if an eternity had been compressed into every moment, rushed over him, he could overcome it.
"...Yes, so that's what it was. To think you had turned back... time."
Silyn analyzed the memories flowing into her head, and with her eyes, she looked down at Jin who was doggedly crawling towards her.
Killing Jin now was a very simple task. She could make the Azure Flame planted in his body grow, or she could swing her sword and instantly sever his limbs.
But Silyn waited quietly. For more of Valeria's memories to flow in, for Jin, for his struggle, to come closer to her.

"What are you doing, Silyn Zipple? Savoring... the victory? Do you think you've won? Cut me down, and I will be reborn. Does it sound like a lie? Have you never seen such a thing? I'll show you. I'll let you know what it is. So Valeria, stop crying. Don't cry. Don't beg. We haven't lost yet. The future is unknown, you said it. The end hasn't been decided yet."
Silyn still stared at Jin, holding the orb. Now, the distance between her and Jin was only two steps. A distance where he could stab her, if only he could extend his sword.
"Heok, heok, heok, keoheok...!"
A clot of blood blocked his throat, suffocating him.
Finally, his eyelids closed. No matter how hard he tried to force them open, they wouldn't. But Jin moved forward even with his eyes closed.
To stab Silyn, to reach his people.
He stood up.
Jin didn't know if he was standing or crawling now. But Valeria and Silyn were watching him stand tall on his two legs.
"Keok, keok, keuh-heup, ka-aaaak!"
Puk...!
The blade dug into Silyn's chest.
It was her heart. Jin had stabbed his sword into Silyn's heart and then collapsed onto her as if in an embrace.

Silyn had watched all of Jin's slow and clumsy movements without once closing her eyes, and even after Jin collapsed into her arms, she did not take her eyes off the ten-or-so-step path he had crawled.
Hahahaha...!
Then she burst into laughter as if mad with joy. She continued to laugh uproariously with Barisada pierced through her heart, then looked at Jin and said this.
"Yes... This is Runcandel."
Jin squeezed his remaining strength and twisted the blade.
Was it because he had stabbed Silyn? His eyes opened. The clot of blood blocking his throat also shot out of his mouth.
"What's... so... funny, Silyn Zipple... Didn't I tell you? That I would kill you."
"Well... the moment for Zipple to finally end has come, so how can I not laugh? Finally."
"What...?"
Soon, Silyn slowly removed her mask. She had the face of a person Jin knew better than anyone.
It was Rosa Runcandel.
